assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Composition changes or loses a canonical spelling; removing any of the five registrations first makes strict parse raise, as the five removal logs show. case.name is a fixed expected spelling, not a supplied expected return value.
Reparsing the composed name changes the IR. This is a metamorphic consistency assertion, not an independent semantic oracle; semantic expectations are fixed by the other assertions.
The token disappears from its expected segment map, even if another grammar decomposition still accepts the spelling.
A list token is removed or its independent resource comment no longer equals the fixed accepted definition.
The registry definition differs from the accepted literal; that literal is not passed into the resource loader.
The breakdown locus becomes another type or loses/adds/reorders an allowed relation relative to the accepted [at, of, along] contract.
A physical base ceases to be scalar, current_profile_alignment loses inherent dimensionality, or plateau_factor acquires it.
Either parsed pellet population has a subject other than its independently named intact/shattered identity.
Either pellet name changes physical_base away from number_density, even if both change together.
Either distinct subject is missing from the subject segment map.

The sourced species quantity changes spelling; removing only phrase-scope registration makes strict parse reject electron_sourced_current_density canonicalization, as sourced_scope-removal.log records.
The flat result loses electron, sourced, or current_density or assigns one to a different segment.
The independent scope registry no longer includes sourced.
The parsed sourced qualifier disappears or has a category other than source; the expected category is a literal.
The forbidden noun source is registered as a qualifier alongside sourced.
